SELECT COALESCE(t.product_id, 0) AS productId, MAX(t.product_name) AS productName, MAX(t.unit) AS unit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(t.total_stock), 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(t.total_value), 0) / SUM(t.total_stock) ELSE 0 END AS costPrice, COALESCE(SUM(t.warehouse_stock), 0) AS warehouseStock, COALESCE(SUM(t.store_stock), 0) AS storeStock, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_stock), 0) AS totalStock, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_value), 0) AS totalValue, COALESCE(MAX(t.store_count), 0) AS storeCount FROM ( -- 仓库库存汇总 SELECT i.material_id AS product_id, MAX(i.material_name) AS product_name, MAX(i.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(SUM(i.current_stock), 0) AS warehouse_stock, 0 AS store_stock, COALESCE(SUM(i.current_stock), 0) AS total_stock, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_cost), 0) AS total_value, 0 AS store_count FROM inventory i WHERE i.deleted = 0
AND i.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
GROUP BY i.material_id
UNION ALL
-- 门店库存汇总 SELECT si.material_id AS product_id, MAX(si.material_name) AS product_name, MAX(si.unit) AS unit, 0 AS warehouse_stock, COALESCE(SUM(si.current_stock), 0) AS store_stock, COALESCE(SUM(si.current_stock), 0) AS total_stock, COALESCE(SUM(si.total_cost), 0) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT si.store_id) AS store_count FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.deleted = 0
AND si.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
GROUP BY si.material_id ) t GROUP BY t.product_id ORDER BY totalStock DESC
